content_sections.heading: About the Recruitment
content_sections.text: A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd. describes itself in the notice as an outsourced contractor for manpower services. It is looking for ICU/OT Technicians to be placed on contract at Tata Memorial Centre-ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai-410 210. The notice is signed by the Supervisor.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for one post, ICU/OT Technician. A candidate must meet any one of the three qualification options below. Option 1: minimum 6 months to 1 year work experience as ICU / OT Technician is desirable. Option 2: one year work experience as OT / ICU Technician is desirable. Option 3: one year work experience as ICU / OT Technician in a reputed hospital is mandatory. The candidate should have a valid Maharashtra Paramedical Council Registration certificate. At least applied for Maharashtra Paramedical Council Registration certificate. The candidate should be willing to work in shift duties including night shifts, Sundays and Holidays. Up to 33 years (may be relaxed on basis of working experience). The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. The duration of the engagement is 6 months (extendable as per requirement). Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility wording.

rows.qualification_required: B.Sc. with 55% marks and one year certificate / diploma course in ICU / OT Technician / Respiratory therapy Technician.
Bachelor degree in Paramedical Technology – OT Techniques / Bachelor degree in Respiratory Therapy / or Equivalent with minimum 55% marks in bachelor degree.
B.Sc. with 55 % marks and one year work experience as ICU / OT Technician in a reputed Hospital is mandatory.

rows.pay: Consolidated ₹26,630/- p.m. to ₹35,000/- p.m. (on the basis of experience over and above specified eligibility criteria)

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bio-data Recent passport size photograph Scanned copies of Aadhar Card Scanned copies of PAN Card ORIGINAL and self-attested copies of qualification mark sheet, certificates and experience certificates

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates report between 10.00 a.m. and 10.30 a.m. on 18 November 2026 at the venue and attend the interview. The notice describes no other stage.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is on contract basis through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., not through Tata Memorial Centre directly. The age limit may be relaxed on the basis of working experience. Pay within the range depends on experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria. The contract period of 6 months is extendable as per requirement.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ACTREC ICU/OT Technician walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, with reporting from 10.00 a.m. to 10.30 a.m.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at Meeting Room-306, 3rd floor, Paymaster Shodhika, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai-410210.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ICU/OT Technician?
faq.answer: The options are B.Sc. with 55% marks plus a one year certificate/diploma in ICU/OT Technician or Respiratory therapy Technician, or a Bachelor degree in Paramedical Technology – OT Techniques or Respiratory Therapy (or equivalent) with minimum 55% marks, or B.Sc. with 55% marks and one year work experience as ICU/OT Technician in a reputed hospital.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 33 years, and it may be relaxed on the basis of working experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for ICU/OT Technician?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is ₹26,630/- p.m. to ₹35,000/- p.m., depending on experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents should candidates bring?
faq.answer: Bring bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, scanned copies of Aadhar Card and PAN Card, and original and self-attested copies of qualification mark sheet, certificates and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is on contract basis through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd. for a duration of 6 months, extendable as per requirement.

faq.question: Q8. Is Maharashtra Paramedical Council Registration required?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a valid Maharashtra Paramedical Council Registration certificate, or at least have applied for it.

faq.question: Q9. Will candidates have to work night shifts?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates should be willing to work in shift duties including night shifts, Sundays and Holidays.
